add_library(OpenSSL STATIC)

target_folder(OpenSSL ${FOLDER_EXTERNAL})

target_include_directories(OpenSSL
  PUBLIC
  ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}
  PRIVATE
  ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/openssl
)

target_compile_options(OpenSSL
  PRIVATE
  $<$<CXX_COMPILER_ID:MSVC>:/wd4005>
  $<$<CXX_COMPILER_ID:MSVC>:/wd4244>
  $<$<CXX_COMPILER_ID:MSVC>:/wd4267>
  $<$<CXX_COMPILER_ID:MSVC>:/wd4311>
  $<$<CXX_COMPILER_ID:MSVC>:/wd4456>
  $<$<CXX_COMPILER_ID:MSVC>:/wd4996>
  $<$<CXX_COMPILER_ID:Clang>:-Wno-deprecated-declarations>
  $<$<CXX_COMPILER_ID:Clang>:-Wno-macro-redefined>
  $<$<CXX_COMPILER_ID:Clang>:-Wno-pointer-to-int-cast>
)

target_compile_definitions(OpenSSL
  PRIVATE
  _CRT_SECURE_NO_WARNINGS
)

target_sources(OpenSSL
  PRIVATE
  src/asn1_lib.c
  src/a_bitstr.c
  src/a_d2i_fp.c
  src/a_dup.c
  src/a_int.c
  src/a_object.c
  src/a_type.c
  src/bio_lib.c
  src/bn_add.c
  src/bn_asm.c
  src/bn_blind.c
  src/bn_ctx.c
  src/bn_div.c
  src/bn_exp.c
  src/bn_exp2.c
  src/bn_gcd.c
  src/bn_kron.c
  src/bn_lib.c
  src/bn_mod.c
  src/bn_mont.c
  src/bn_mul.c
  src/bn_prime.c
  src/bn_print.c
  src/bn_rand.c
  src/bn_recp.c
  src/bn_shift.c
  src/bn_sqr.c
  src/bn_sqrt.c
  src/bn_word.c
  src/bss_file.c
  src/buffer.c
  src/buf_str.c
  src/b_print.c
  src/cryptlib.c
  src/dh_check.c
  src/dh_key.c
  src/dh_lib.c
  src/digest.c
  src/dsa_asn1.c
  src/dsa_depr.c
  src/dsa_err.c
  src/dsa_gen.c
  src/dsa_key.c
  src/dsa_lib.c
  src/dsa_ossl.c
  src/dsa_sign.c
  src/dsa_utl.c
  src/dsa_vrf.c
  src/eng_ctrl.c
  src/eng_init.c
  src/eng_lib.c
  src/eng_list.c
  src/eng_table.c
  src/err.c
  src/err_def.c
  src/ex_data.c
  src/lhash.c
  src/md_rand.c
  src/mem.c
  src/mem_clr.c
  src/m_sha1.c
  src/obj_dat.c
  src/obj_lib.c
  src/rand_eng.c
  src/rand_lib.c
  src/rand_win.c
  src/rsa_lib.c
  src/rsa_sign.c
  src/sha1dgst.c
  src/sha1_one.c
  src/sha256.c
  src/sha512.c
  src/sha_dgst.c
  src/sha_one.c
  src/stack.c
  src/tasn_dec.c
  src/tasn_enc.c
  src/tasn_fre.c
  src/tasn_new.c
  src/tasn_typ.c
  src/tasn_utl.c
  src/tb_dh.c
  src/tb_digest.c
  src/tb_dsa.c
  src/tb_rand.c
  src/x_algor.c
  src/x_bignum.c
  src/x_long.c
  src/x_sig.c
)
